name: Crimson Invite
descriptionTemplate: Doresain gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: Gain [Power:Arg2] {STR}. DMG dealt by Doresain gains an extra [Arg3]% {STR} Bonus. After Doresain's first kill each turn, deal {Pure DMG} equal to 50% of the overflow DMG to other enemies.
lore: The invitation's paper is supple skin. Its adornments, polished skulls. Its ink, still-warm blood. Its seal, the fervent mark of the banquet's host—Doresain, who extends to you a most... personal summon.
